    ecpt[7] = 0.0;   // non-structural mass (ECPT(8))
    ecpt[8] = 0.0;   // coord sys A (ECPT(9))
    ecpt[9] = x_a;   // x A (ECPT(10))
    ecpt[10] = y_a;  // y A (ECPT(11))
    ecpt[11] = z_a;  // z A (ECPT(12))
    ecpt[12] = 0.0;  // coord sys B (ECPT(13))

    double y1 = ecpt[ka+2];   // y-coordinate of pivotal node (ECPT(KA+3) -> index ka+2)
    double z1 = ecpt[ka+3];   // z-coordinate of pivotal node (ECPT(KA+4) -> index ka+3)
    double x2 = ecpt[kb+1];   // x-coordinate of non-pivotal node (ECPT(KB+2) -> index kb+1)
    double y2 = ecpt[kb+2];   // y-coordinate of non-pivotal node (ECPT(KB+3) -> index kb+2)

    n[3] = xn[1] * xn[0];  // (1,0)

    // Top-left block (0:2, 0:2): dscl * N

        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
            k_global(i, j) = dscl * n[i*3 + j];
        }

    // Top-right block (0:2, 6:8): -dscl * N
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
            k_global(i, 6+j) = -dscl * n[i*3 + j];
        }
    }
    
    // Bottom-left block (6:8, 0:2): -dscl * N
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
            k_global(6+i, j) = -dscl * n[i*3 + j];
        }
    }
    
    // Bottom-right block (6:8, 6:8): dscl * N
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
            k_global(6+i, 6+j) = dscl * n[i*3 + j];
        }
    }
    
    // Torsional stiffness: couples rotational DOFs (3-5 for node A, 9-11 for node B)
    // For CROD, torsional stiffness only couples the rotations about the element axis (rx)
    // So only DOF indices 3 (rx_A) and 9 (rx_B) are affected
    // k_global(3,3) = dscr
    // k_global(3,9) = -dscr
    // k_global(9,3) = -dscr
    // k_global(9,9) = dscr
    k_global(3, 3) = dscr;
    k_global(3, 9) = -dscr;
    k_global(9, 3) = -dscr;
    k_global(9, 9) = dscr;

    return k_global;
}

    if (pos != std::string::npos && result[pos] == '.') {
